# Route53

AWS Route 53 is a scalable and highly available domain name system (DNS) service designed to give developers and businesses an extremely reliable and cost-effective way to route users to Internet applications. This DNS service effectively connects user requests to infrastructure running in Amazon Web Services (AWS) ΓÇô such as an Amazon EC2 instance, an Amazon Elastic Load Balancer, or an Amazon S3 bucket ΓÇô and can also be used to route users to infrastructure outside of AWS. Route 53 conceals the complexities of the underlying DNS protocol, offering developers an easy-to-use and cost-effective domain registration service. It features domain transfer capabilities, DNS failover, health checks, and customizable TTLs.
